title: Jonah and the Choir
author: Vesper Joubert
blurb: Theo Dunmore, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
